_comment: Read by scenarios.ts, by tools/visual and by the QA report, so the scenario count everywhere is the number the spec really generates. A scenario is one page at one viewport. Priority is chosen by the longest matching prefix: p0 (a customer cannot use the product without it, or it guards their data), p2 (operator, marketing and one-off pages); any other signed-in page is p1. Pages with a [param] need real data and are left out; the QA report counts them.

known./templates/new: real defect: React hydration error #418 (a text mismatch between the server render and the browser) on every load of the page, with the real clock. Owner: message-templates. Fix: find the value rendered differently on the server and the client (a date, a locale string or Math.random) and render it after mount.
known./credit-notes/new: real defect: React hydration error #418 when the browser date differs from the server date (the default date is computed while rendering). The suite fixes the browser clock, which exposes it; a visitor in another time zone near midnight sees it too. Owner: invoicing. Fix: compute the default date after mount.
